tagline: Topcon胶片单反相机，1973 年发布
description: Topcon于1973年推出的胶片单反相机。使用Single stroke lever (120°).。感光度25 to 3200 ASA (plus DIN scale).。

specs.卡口: Topcon UV bayonet. The mount included a locking facility when Topcor UV lenses are attached.
specs.曝光测光: Automatic shutter speed priority (1/8th to 1/500th), or fully manual.
specs.尺寸: 141 x 93 x 59mm (W x H x D).
specs.电池: 2 x 1.35v PX625A mercury battery (use the equivalent WeinCELL MRB625 zinc air cell).
specs.英文简介: The Topcon IC-1 Auto is a 1973-1978 35mm SLR from Tokyo Kogaku named for the Integrated Circuit which controlled its shutter priority auto exposure.
